title: Mid-infrared single-pixel imaging: original protected laboratory assets

source.title: Mid-infrared single-pixel imaging at the single-photon level
source.paper_license: CC BY 4.0; no source images, figures, CAD, code or movies included

dimension_semantics: Every position, equipment size, carrier interface, aperture glyph and grip is original nominal geometry. Only the silicon 200 micrometre thickness is source-referenced; it is not a qualified drawing. Optical components and wavelengths remain factual metadata, not dimensional manufacturing inputs. Actual object dimensions/transforms are listed in asset_inventory.json.
optical_boundary: Opaque closed service shells; no internal source optical layout, beam paths or photon telemetry. Materials and studio light are display choices, not calibrated optics.
rate_boundary: Approximately 10 Hz belongs only to the source 16x16 dynamic analog branch; 32x32 is about 2.5 Hz. No photon-count branch receives these rates.
